title: Technical architecture of the VerteTIME compilation framework
text: vt_alpha_diversity(x, indices) returns one row per (dataset_id, site_id, year, index) triple. Supported indices S (richness), H (Shannon entropy nats), D (Simpson’s 1 - sum(p^2)), q0 / q1 / q2 (Hill numbers order 0, 1, 2), Chao1 (bias-corrected Chao 1984 estimator). indices computed pure R, vegan optional cross-validation dependency. Hill-number profile across q [0, 3] exposed via vt_plot_hill_profile() per-dataset diagnostics. vt_evenness(x, kind) returns Pielou J = H / log(S) Simpson evenness (1 / (1 - D)) / S. undefined S < 2; function returns NA rather 0 Inf regime.

title: Technical architecture of the VerteTIME compilation framework
text: vt_beta_diversity(x, method) computes pairwise dissimilarity sites within dataset (Bray-Curtis, Jaccard, Hellinger) plus Whittaker multiplicative scalar gamma / mean(alpha) - 1 summarised dataset level. Single-site datasets return NA pairwise matrices defined Whittaker scalar. vt_temporal_turnover(x, method, pair) computes pairwise year--year dissimilarity within site one three pair patterns: consecutive (year t vs year t+1), first_vs_each (year_min vs every year), all_pairs (every distinct t_a < t_b). vt_beta_partition(x, family) implements Baselga (2010) decomposition pairwise temporal Sorensen dissimilarity Simpson turnover component nestedness-resultant component. identity beta_sor = beta_sim + beta_nes holds numerical precision across compilation.

title: Technical architecture of the VerteTIME compilation framework
text: vt_dominance_curve(), vt_rank_abundance(), vt_rarefaction() vt_nestedness() complete community-structure surface. NODF (Almeida-Neto et al. 2008) computed year--species presence-absence matrices per (dataset_id, site_id). Hurlbert-Sanders rarefaction returns expected richness target sample size, NA year-site total falls requested sample.

title: Community metrics in VerteTIME
text: build single dataset eight species, fifteen years explicit cohort effect temporal-turnover Baselga partition produce non-trivial signals.
code: library(VerteTIME) library(data.table) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2)  spp_lab <- paste0("Genus_", letters[1:8]) years   <- 2010:2024  # Cohort effect: half the species peak early, half peak late, two species are # always present, two species are intermittently present (zeroes in some years). mat <- vapply(seq_along(spp_lab), function(s) {   base <- 12 + 3 * s   tbias <- if (s <= 4) -2 * (seq_along(years) - 1) else 2 * (seq_along(years) - 1)   noise <- rnorm(length(years), sd = 1.6)   v <- pmax(round(base + tbias + noise), 0)   if (s %in% c(7, 8)) {     v[sample(seq_along(years), size = 5)] <- 0   }   v }, numeric(length(years)))  obs <- as.data.table(expand.grid(year = years, species_id = spp_lab,                                  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,                                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)) obs[, value := as.numeric(mat[cbind(match(year, years), match(species_id, spp_lab))])] obs[, dataset_id := "VT_001"]; obs[, site_id := "VT_001"] setcolorder(obs, c("dataset_id","site_id","species_id","year","value"))  ds <- data.table(dataset_id = "VT_001", dataset_label = "Synthetic richer",                  latitude_dd = 0, longitude_dd = 30, coord_precision_km = 1,                  country_iso3 = NA_character_, realm = NA_character_,                  biome = NA_character_, ecoregion = NA_character_,                  year_min = min(years), year_max = max(years),                  n_years = length(years), n_species = length(spp_lab),                  n_covariates = 0L, is_community_metric_eligible = TRUE,                  unit_class = "count", taxonomic_focus = "mixed", notes = "") sites <- data.table(site_id = "VT_001", dataset_id = "VT_001",                     site_label = "Synthetic site", latitude_dd = 0,                     longitude_dd = 30, elevation_m = NA_real_,                     habitat = "synthetic", coord_precision_km = 1) species <- data.table(species_id = spp_lab, genus = "Genus",                       species_epithet = letters[1:8],                       class = NA_character_, order = NA_character_,                       family = NA_character_, is_vertebrate = NA) co <- vt_compilation(datasets = ds, sites = sites, species = species,                 observations = obs) co #> <vt_compilation> with 1 dataset(s) #>   sites              : 1 #>   species            : 8 #>   observation rows   : 120 #>   covariates rows    : 0 #>   year range         : 2010-2024 #>   community-eligible : 1 / 1

text: Ingestion pipeline: vt_ingest_dataset(), vt_ingest_all(), vt_validate(). Future-dataset registration: vt_register_dataset() reading per-dataset YAML sidecar. Reading reshaping: vt_read(), vt_long(), vt_wide(), vt_compilation(). Alpha-diversity metrics: vt_alpha_diversity() (richness, Shannon, Simpson, Hill numbers q=0,1,2, Chao1) vt_evenness() (Pielou, Simpson). Beta-diversity turnover: vt_beta_diversity() (Bray-Curtis, Jaccard, Hellinger, Whittaker multiplicative), vt_temporal_turnover(), vt_beta_partition() (Baselga 2010 turnover/nestedness components). Composition: vt_dominance_curve(), vt_rank_abundance(), vt_rarefaction(), vt_nestedness() (NODF). Aggregators filters: vt_community_summary(), vt_compilation_summary(), vt_filter(). Multi-format export: vt_export() writing CSV, Apache Parquet, SQLite single-file, Frictionless Data Package; vt_publish() orchestrator producing full web-export/vertetime-v1.0/ tree. Visualisation: vt_plot_whittaker(), vt_plot_rac(), vt_plot_alpha_timeline(), vt_plot_beta_heatmap(), vt_plot_world_map() (Robinson projection), vt_plot_database_timeline() (positional comparator across vertebrate time-series compilations). S3 classes bidirectional print / summary / plot: vt_dataset, vt_compilation, vt_diversity, vt_turnover, vt_provenance.
